breezeml 0.0.1
  • Reference
  • Changelog

    Assemble the full reproducible R script from every tab's state, in skeleton.Rmd order. Pure function. Paths in the emitted script reference the data_package_creation working directory, since that's where EMLassemblyline's template functions and make_eml() actually operate.

    build_generation_script.Rd

    Includes the FULL pipeline as actually executed by run_generation() - make_eml() through the post-make_eml() EMLeditor edits (permissions, org context, DOI) - not just the make_eml()/validate/write_eml() portion. Previously this function stopped after write_eml() and never emitted any of the Tab 7/8/9 EMLeditor::set_*() calls at all, making the "Preview script" button and the generation_script.R written to disk both incomplete/non-reproducible relative to what the app actually does.

    build_generation_script(
  high_level_state,
  people_state,
  tables_state,
  fields_state,
  geo_state,
  taxonomy_state,
  permissions_state,
  org_context_state,
  working_folder_var = "working_folder"
)

    Arguments

    high_level_state

    the list returned by highLevelServer()'s reactive

    people_state

    the list returned by peopleServer()'s reactive

    tables_state

    the list returned by tableMetadataServer()'s reactive

    fields_state

    the list returned by fieldsServer()'s reactive's $tables

    geo_state

    the list returned by geographyServer()'s reactive

    taxonomy_state

    the list returned by taxonomyServer()'s reactive

    permissions_state

    the list returned by permissionsServer()'s reactive

    org_context_state

    the list returned by org_contextServer()'s reactive

    working_folder_var

    name of the R variable holding the working folder path in the generated script (default "working_folder")

    Value

    character - the full generated R script as a single string
